source: scenes.mjs sceneFor(map): a fresh createArena(new Scene(), config), load(map), setCore(corePreset), the nav grid built as main.js builds it, then buildNavGraph(arena.map, arena.octree, config, arena.core, grid)
nodeNote: nodes[i] = the web node {x, y, z, kind, group, pad?}; a pad node's `pad` (the map.pads entry) is written as its index in map.pads
edgeNote: edges[i] = the out-edges of node i in the web's order: {to, cost (s), kind, back? (m, standing techniques backed off)}
timingNote: `ms` (buildNavGraph alone) and `gridMs` (the nav grid build) are this machine's wall times; verify.mjs skips them
